selection_principle: Controlled physical conditions, retained sensor channels, credible metadata, defensible holdout unit, official source, practical raw replay.

datasets.name: UCI Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems
datasets.use: 14 physical channels, four component conditions, 144 fault combinations

datasets.name: MAFAULDA
datasets.status: 42 original recordings executed across two frozen phases
datasets.use: Synchronized microphone, six accelerometer axes and tachometer; known induced mechanical faults
datasets.limitation: Small three-state subset; one rig; tachometer excluded from diagnosis
datasets.license: No explicit dataset license found on official landing page; raw not redistributed

datasets.name: MIMII original
datasets.use: Eight-microphone array, four machine types, machine IDs and factory-noise mixtures
datasets.limitation: Keep noise variants and original recordings together; about 100 GB for the full release

datasets.name: MIMII DUE
datasets.limitation: Anomaly benchmark; channel and intervention semantics require separate audit

datasets.name: ToyADMOS original
datasets.limitation: Very large split archives; source license PDF authoritative

datasets.name: DCASE 2020 Task 2 derivative
datasets.limitation: Single-channel derivative cannot establish microphone-placement advantage

datasets.name: IDMT-ISA-ELECTRIC-ENGINE
datasets.use: 2,378 mono recordings of three motors with operating and noise conditions

datasets.name: CWRU Bearing Data Center
datasets.use: Known seeded bearing faults, drive/fan/base accelerometers, operating loads
datasets.limitation: Keep original recordings and fault installations grouped; multiple positions not interchangeable channels

datasets.name: NASA/IMS Bearings
datasets.limitation: Run-to-failure sequences require run/device holdouts, not random windows

datasets.name: Real-IAD
datasets.use: Five camera views per physical object; candidate for camera-view selection
datasets.limitation: Authenticated data access; group all views of each physical sample; site-source licence is not dataset licence
datasets.license: Verify dataset terms at original access point
